Method of Attack: Trojan disguised as Flash Player installer executing a PowerShell script (zaga.ps1) that downloads a 7-zip archive, extractor, and CMD script from zahr.pw server
CMD script extracts sharchivedmngr to %AppData%\lappclimtfldr and configures Windows to auto-start mcrtvclient.exe
mcrtvclient.exe is a renamed NetSupport Manager Remote Control Software connecting to leyv.pw:11678 to allow remote attacker control
Attack Vector: Compromised Steam accounts used to spam malicious links via Steam chat
Victims tricked into downloading fake Flash Player installer from videomeo.pw
Indicators of Compromise: Files: zaga.ps1 PowerShell script, sharchivedmngr archive, mcrtvclient.exe executable
